about.ourairports: airports with IATA/ICAO codes and coordinates
about.text: AviationLog is a self-hosted log for plane spotters: aircraft, sightings, photos, fleets and spotting locations.
adsbdb.button_hint: Looks up this registration at adsbdb.com and fills in type, manufacturer, Mode S code and operator. Fields you changed yourself (✎) stay.
adsbdb.intro: Free lookup by registration: type, manufacturer, Mode S code and operator. No MSN, build year or fleets. Your own values (✎) are never changed; model and manufacturer are only filled when empty.
adsbdb.lookup_all: Look up all {count} aircraft of the collection
adsbdb.lookup_all_hint: Looks up every spotted aircraft and every aircraft added by hand or by the photo scan, one after another. The result can be reviewed before it is applied.
aircraft.airline_placeholder: Name or ICAO code, e.g. DLH
aircraft.delete: Delete all sightings of this aircraft
aircraft.delete_confirm: Really delete all sightings and photos of this aircraft?
aircraft.edit_hint: Changed fields are marked ✎ and are never overwritten by an import.
aircraft.manual_hint: Edited by hand, protected from imports
aircraft.reg_unknown_set_hint: Enter the real registration once you know it. If it already exists (e.g. from the master data), the sightings and photos move to that aircraft.
aircraft.unlock_hint: Ticked fields will be updated by the next import again.
backups.intro: The database is backed up every day. Photos are not part of the backup: back up your photo folder separately.
backups.restore_hint: Restoring overwrites all current data. Type RESTORE into the field to confirm.
dashboard.no_master_data: No master data yet. Import aircraft, airports, airlines and types first.
data.intro: Master data comes from free public sources. Nothing is changed automatically: every import shows new and changed records for review first. Values you edited by hand are never overwritten.
data.review_hint: Check the changes, correct values if needed and untick records you do not want. Corrected values count as edited by hand.
error.title: Error {status}
field.name: Name
fleet.add_aircraft_hint: For aircraft not yet in the master data, e.g. a new delivery you want to spot. It shows up in the fleet as "missing". Filled-in fields are never overwritten by an import.
fleet.aircraft_exists: {registration} already exists. Change its airline there to add it to this fleet:
fleet.inactive_hint: Retired or stored aircraft still in the database? Mark them inactive, then they no longer count for the fleet.
fleet.intro: Active aircraft of each airline you have spotted, compared to its whole active fleet from the master data.
login.2fa_recovery_hint: Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.
login.desktop_start: First login: user {username}, password {password}. Change the password under Profile after logging in; this hint then disappears.
login.title: Login
map.intro: Your spotting locations and airports. Bigger circles mean more sightings.
master.delete_blocked: Cannot be deleted while sightings are linked to it.
master.delete_hint_airline: The aircraft of this airline are kept, just without airline.
master.delete_hint_airport: The spotting locations of this airport are deleted too.
master.duplicate_airline: An active airline with ICAO code {code} already exists:
master.duplicate_airport: An airport with ICAO code {code} already exists:
master.edit_hint: Changed fields are marked with ✎ and never overwritten by an import.
master.error_airline_iata: An airline IATA code has 2 characters (letters or digits), e.g. LH.
master.error_airline_icao: An airline ICAO code has 3 letters, e.g. DLH.
master.error_airport_iata: An airport IATA code has 3 letters, e.g. MUC.
master.error_airport_icao: An airport ICAO code has 4 characters, e.g. EDDM.
master.error_coordinates: Please enter coordinates as decimal numbers, e.g. 48.353783 (latitude up to ±90, longitude up to ±180).
master.new_hint_airline: For airlines missing from the master data. If it has an ICAO code, the next airline import merges it with the matching entry; your values are kept.
master.new_hint_airport: For airports missing from the master data. If it has an ICAO code, the next airport import merges it with the matching entry; your values are kept.
msg.adsbdb_unchanged: adsbdb.com has no new data for this aircraft.
msg.delete_has_sightings: Cannot delete: sightings are still linked to it.
msg.import_started: Import started. The review opens when it is ready.
msg.job_running: Another job is still running. Please wait.
msg.password_invalid: Passwords must match and have at least 8 characters.
msg.recovery_code_used: Logged in with a recovery code. {count} codes left.
msg.registration_invalid: That registration is not valid (letters, digits, + . - only).
msg.remove_missing_started: Removing photos whose files are gone.
msg.restore_not_confirmed: Restore cancelled: type RESTORE to confirm.
msg.upload_disabled: Uploads are disabled in NAS mode.
msg.user_last_admin: The last admin cannot be removed.
msg.user_self: You cannot do this to yourself.
opensky.cite: If you use OpenSky Network data in a publication (including web pages, research papers or public presentations), please cite:
opensky.notice: The OpenSky aircraft database is unlicensed and does not fall under OpenSky's terms of use. There is no support or guarantee of any kind; the data is offered "as is".
photo.delete_confirm_nas: Remove this photo from AviationLog? The file on the NAS stays, delete it there or it comes back with the next scan.
photo.delete_confirm_upload: Delete this photo? The file is deleted as well.
photo.missing: The file is missing on disk.
photos.delete_entry_tip: Removes this entry from the list. The folder on the NAS stays and shows up again with the next scan.
photos.nas_hint: The archive is only read, never changed. The scan lists new folders; check the detected values, correct them if needed and apply. Corrections are remembered per folder.
photos.need_airports: Import the airports first, otherwise the airport codes in the folder names cannot be resolved.
photos.problem_structure: folder depth does not match the scheme
photos.reg_unknown_hint: the photos go to a new aircraft without registration, you can add the registration later on the aircraft page
photos.remove_missing: Remove photos whose files are gone
photos.remove_missing_confirm: Remove all photos whose files no longer exist?
photos.remove_missing_tip: Removes photos from AviationLog whose file no longer exists (e.g. deleted or moved on the NAS). Only the database entry and preview are removed; sightings and aircraft stay. Nothing on the NAS is deleted. Only use it while the NAS share is mounted, otherwise every photo counts as missing.
photos.scan_tip: Walks through the whole photo folder and rebuilds the review list: all entries not applied yet (Open, To check) are discarded and listed again from the current state on the NAS. Saved corrections are kept and applied again. Nothing on the NAS is changed.
photos.thumbnails_tip: Creates missing preview images and reads missing camera data for photos already in AviationLog.
photos.unreadable_hint: These folders or files have names with characters that are not valid UTF-8 (often umlauts saved by an old program) and were skipped. Rename them on the NAS, then scan again.
photos.upload_disabled: Uploads are disabled in NAS mode.
photos.upload_hint: Upload mode: photos are uploaded with a sighting and stored in the folder scheme, so you can switch to NAS mode later.
profile.2fa_step1: 1. Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (or enter the key by hand):
profile.2fa_step2: 2. Enter the code from the app to confirm:
profile.2fa_text: Protect your account with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password …).
profile.recovery_codes_text: Store them somewhere safe. Each code works once, if you lose access to your authenticator app. They are shown only now.
reset.invalid: This link is invalid or expired.
reset.mail_body:
Hello {username},

to choose a new password for AviationLog open this link within one hour:

{link}

If you did not ask for this, just ignore this mail.
reset.no_smtp: Password reset by e-mail is not set up. Please ask an admin to reset your password.
reset.sent: If the address belongs to a user, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.
reset.title: Reset password
sighting.date_hint: Leave the date empty to use the capture date of the first photo.
sighting.delete_confirm: Delete this sighting with all its photos?
sighting.lookup_unknown: Not in the database yet: please add type and airline below.
sighting.nas_hint: NAS mode: photos come from the archive scan and are linked to this sighting automatically.
sighting.new_aircraft_hint: This registration is not in the database yet. It will be created with these details:
spot.delete_confirm: Delete this spotting location? Sightings keep their airport.
spot.new_hint: Click on the map to place the pin.
users.no_smtp: SMTP is not configured, so users cannot reset their password by e-mail. Admins can set new passwords here.
users.reset_2fa_confirm: Turn off two-factor authentication for this user?
